description: This shell script is part of a test suite for Git push options, setting up repositories, hooks, and performing push operations with push options. It includes functions for repository setup (mk_repo_pair), tests for push options behavior with various configurations, and interactions with remote servers over HTTP and local repositories.

methods.name: mk_repo_pair
methods.description: Sets up a pair of repositories ('upstream' and 'workbench') with specific hooks to test push options, configuring repositories for subsequent push operations and tests.

methods.name: test_refs
methods.description: Compares the specified refs in upstream and workbench repositories to verify they are identical.

methods.name: mk_http_pair
methods.description: Sets up an HTTP server environment with a repository configured to accept push options or not, and clones it for testing HTTP push interactions.
